author: beaver state news
title: City of Portland announces new benefit plan starting July 1
text:
The City of Portland announced on June 24 that its new employee benefit plan will begin on July 1, with employees seeing updated benefit deductions reflected in their July 9 paycheck. The city advised employees to double-check their benefit deductions for the upcoming year.
The announcement outlined important dates and resources intended to help employees maximize their benefits during the new plan year. Many programs require additional steps such as setting up an account or downloading an app, and the city encouraged staff to verify which benefits need action and to contact support if assistance is needed.
New Moda ID cards accompanied by an engagement guide have been mailed to all employees enrolled in a Moda plan, including CityCore, CityNet, CityBasic, CityHD, and CityHDP. Employees are able to log into their accounts now.
Employees were reminded to set up all necessary Moda accounts ahead of the new year in order to access available benefits without delay. Detailed plan summaries and contact information are available through official channels, with the city team offering support for any questions regarding access or enrollment.
The city reiterated its commitment to supporting staff throughout this transition period.
